gaps.title: Project tab pages can crash because frontend treats object read models as arrays
repo_evidence: ProjectMeetingsPage, ProjectFieldOperationsPage, and ProjectCostTimePage assign items=(data?.items || data || []) and call items.slice(); backend project tab endpoints return objects with metric_cards/attention_items/sections, not arrays.
gaps.why_it_matters: Blocks core Projects usability for Meetings, Field Operations, and Cost & Time; local browser route can render a TypeError even while backend API returns 200.
gaps.recommended_fix: Normalize project tab responses in a shared adapter; render metric_cards and attention_items; or add backend items arrays. Add tests that each route renders when backend returns object envelopes.

gaps.title: My Items page calls unimplemented backend subroutes
repo_evidence: Frontend calls /api/my-items/action-items, /meetings, /correspondence, /files, /followed-projects; backend route inventory exposes only /api/my-items.
gaps.why_it_matters: Creates failed React Query requests and noisy console/network errors; undermines the user-specific work queue.
gaps.recommended_fix: Either add backend compatibility section endpoints derived from build_my_items() or refactor frontend to use the aggregate /api/my-items only.
tests_validation_required: pytest app shell openapi path assertion
new pytest my-items section routes or updated frontend no-call test

gaps.title: Projects portfolio selector does not consume backend project_keys
repo_evidence: ProjectsPage expects portfolio.projects or portfolio.items array; backend build_projects_portfolio returns project_keys, metric_cards, attention_items, and sections.
gaps.why_it_matters: Individual projects may not appear even when backend has project_keys, so Projects feels empty/demo-like.
gaps.recommended_fix: Adapt ProjectsPage to build project cards from project_keys and metric_cards, or update backend to emit a projects array with key/name/freshness/status.

gaps.title: Settings page still exposes raw JSON/debug response panels
gaps.why_it_matters: Conflicts with polished local-first app direction and can make Settings feel like a backend test harness.
gaps.recommended_fix: Replace raw JSON panels with concise status cards and optional admin-only redacted diagnostics routed to Admin/Data Confidence.
tests_validation_required: grep no Raw response in SettingsPage

gaps.title: Daily Brief currentState expression has precedence bug
repo_evidence: SettingsPage computes currentState with detectResult?.state || status?.state || status?.config?.enabled === false ? "not_configured" : undefined.
gaps.why_it_matters: Truthy status can incorrectly display not_configured, confusing first-run setup and daily brief confidence.
gaps.recommended_fix: Use explicit parentheses and helper function: if disabled -> not_configured; else detectResult.state ?? status.state. Add test around configured_waiting and brief_available states.

gaps.title: BrowserRouter pages contain hash-style links
repo_evidence: TodayPage uses href="#/settings" and SettingsPage uses href="#/today" despite createBrowserRouter route model.
gaps.why_it_matters: Creates broken or confusing navigation under the Vite BrowserRouter app.

gaps.title: Admin page does not present role-denied state clearly
repo_evidence: AdminDataConfidencePage fires admin-only queries and renders Loading… for missing data; backend requires admin role.
gaps.why_it_matters: With default operator local role, Admin may look broken instead of role-restricted.
gaps.recommended_fix: Detect 403 errors and render a clear “Admin role required” state with local role selector guidance.

gaps.title: Today dashboard is missing explicit required sections
repo_evidence: TodayPage renders Important Today, Daily Brief, Today’s Meetings, What Changed, Action Items, and Portfolio Signals; required explicit Documents/Correspondence and Cost/Change/Time sections are not first-class.
gaps.why_it_matters: Today does not yet fully match the construction command-center brief.
gaps.recommended_fix: Split Portfolio Signals into Cost / Change / Time Signals and Documents & Correspondence Worth Reviewing; keep data confidence compact.
tests_validation_required: no raw calendar body/join URL scan

gaps.title: Hardcoded freshness/confidence values remain on project pages
repo_evidence: ProjectFieldOperationsPage hardcodes stale/19 minutes; other project subpages hardcode fresh/source_backed.
gaps.why_it_matters: Stale/fresh confidence becomes misleading when backend returns actual freshness/confidence.
gaps.recommended_fix: Always bind badges to backend freshness/confidence_summary; default to unknown only when absent.

gaps.title: Settings still feels like backend controls rather than onboarding
repo_evidence: Settings uses Load buttons, sample admin rate limit, “sent (stub)” copy, and fragmented cards.
gaps.why_it_matters: Increases friction and reinforces engineering-console feel.
gaps.recommended_fix: Convert to guided Account Connections, Project Connections, Daily Brief, Preferences sections with preview→save cards and clear next actions.
tests_validation_required: UX smoke path new user setup

gaps.title: alert() error handling remains in Settings
repo_evidence: SettingsPage catch blocks still call alert() for configure, instructions, validate, and detect failures.
gaps.why_it_matters: Alerts interrupt workflow and feel unpolished.
gaps.recommended_fix: Use shared inline ErrorState/Toast-like component with retry actions.

gaps.title: No frontend test harness found
repo_evidence: GitHub search returned no Vitest, Playwright, or Testing Library usage in frontend.
gaps.why_it_matters: Regression risk is high for route/API alignment and browser launch.
gaps.recommended_fix: Add Vitest + React Testing Library for components/adapters and Playwright or scripted browser smoke for local routes.

gaps.title: Responsive/accessibility baseline is incomplete
repo_evidence: AppShell uses fixed sidebar; CSS focus-visible covers anchors/buttons but not inputs/selects; mobile navigation is not evident.
gaps.why_it_matters: Local-first desktop is primary, but production-ready polish still needs keyboard and smaller-window behavior.
gaps.recommended_fix: Add responsive sidebar collapse, focus styles for inputs/selects, skip link, semantic regions, form labels, and accessible loading/error states.

gaps.title: Daily Brief latest endpoint returns bounded Markdown content; needs explicit no-source-raw fixture coverage
repo_evidence: DailyBriefService latest/presentation returns Markdown content and sections from local file; tests assert preservation and no forbidden markers but not all source-raw scenarios.
gaps.why_it_matters: The daily brief is user-authored external Markdown, but safety claims should be explicit for local-first production.
gaps.recommended_fix: Add fixtures for forbidden content, overly long files, parse warnings, stale files, and path display; keep original file unchanged.

gaps.title: Chart readiness dependency exists but chart UX is not implemented
repo_evidence: Recharts is declared but pages use cards/lists only.
gaps.why_it_matters: Trend surfaces will eventually need compact visuals, but not a launch blocker.
gaps.recommended_fix: Defer until route contracts are stable; add chart card only for validated metrics.

gaps.title: Preferences persistence is still an echo stub
repo_evidence: /api/settings/preferences returns hardcoded defaults; PATCH echoes applied payload.
gaps.why_it_matters: Theme is locally persisted in frontend, but default landing/followed projects/preferences are not yet durable through backend.
gaps.recommended_fix: Persist preferences to local Application Support JSON with schema/version and safe validation.

gaps.title: Project keyword UI is informational only
repo_evidence: Settings keywords card tells user to manage per-project /keywords routes rather than providing add/edit/disable UI.
gaps.why_it_matters: Project matching setup remains developer-facing and incomplete for non-technical use.
gaps.recommended_fix: Add project keyword management UI with project selector, active/disabled/excluded lists, preview explain, and safe validation.

gaps.title: End-to-end local smoke harness and runbook are not yet packaged
repo_evidence: Prompt requires backend on 8000 and frontend on 5173 smoke; current repo has scripts but no confirmed E2E smoke harness in frontend.
gaps.why_it_matters: Production-ready local-first use needs repeatable launch validation.
gaps.recommended_fix: Create one command/scripted runbook for install, backend start, frontend start, route smoke, no 404/console errors, and role switching.
tests_validation_required: run documented smoke from clean checkout
